title: biomedical-signal-forensics-lab
description: An open-source Python toolkit for auditing wearable physiological signal pipelines. Targets four failure modes that commonly invalidate downstream conclusions in digital-health research: signal-quality thresholds that pass on real wrist PPG despite consensus rejection by published baselines (Orphanidou 2015, Sukor 2011, Elgendi 2016); algorithmic-fairness disparities driven by device family and skin tone; confounded causal interpretations that reverse sign under back-door adjustment; and small but measurable downstream-task degradation from preprocessing choices. Includes a real-data WESAD validation, AIPW with E-values for causal sensitivity, a downstream classifier audit, and per-item TRIPOD+AI and STARD 2015 compliance documentation.
